teaching_moment_lands: The named teaching moment — field-mapping without ranking, so the student holds 'I know how to learn' as a trained eye rather than a settled answer — triggers reliably across the persona read. The Ronacher counter-position (l.89-101) and the explicit partial-by-design framing (l.11, l.216, l.220-225) prevent the walk from collapsing into a single recommended lineage even under a fast or skimming read; the three-filter close (l.135-141) gives the reader a decision procedure instead of a verdict, which is the module's own point. Not fragile to skill variation: even a persona that skips half the practitioner sections still lands on 'pick what resembles your day' from the closing filters alone.
